description: Use BeyondTrust Password Safe in workflows: request, retrieve and check in privileged credentials, approve requests, change passwords, read and save Secrets Safe secrets, end sessions and manage users' groups. Start a workflow on a new request, an approval, a new account, system, secret, session or user.

beyondtrust_new_managed_account_trigger.description: Runs for each new managed account you can request in BeyondTrust Password Safe. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 5,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.account_id: The managed account's id, for 'Request credentials'.
output.application_name: The application, for an application account.
output.domain_name: Its domain, for a domain account.
output.instance_name: The database instance, for a database account.
output.is_changing: True while its password is being changed.
output.isa_access: True if the run-as user has ISA access.
output.system_id: The managed system it is on.
output.user_principal_name: Its user principal name, if any.

beyondtrust_new_managed_system_trigger.description: Runs for each new managed system in BeyondTrust. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 5,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.asset_id: The id of its asset, if any.
output.auto_management: True if Password Safe changes its passwords itself.
output.entity_type: Asset, Database, Directory, Cloud or Unknown.
output.name: Its name.

beyondtrust_new_request_trigger.description: Runs for each new credential request waiting for your approval in BeyondTrust Password Safe. Ones already waiting when the workflow is turned on don't start it. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.access_type: What was asked for: View, RDP, SSH or App.
output.approved_date: When it was approved, if it was.
output.canceled_date: When it was cancelled, if it was.
output.request_id: The request's id, for 'Approve request' or 'Deny request'.
output.requestor_user_id: The id of the user who asked.
output.status: The request's status, as Password Safe words it.
output.system_id: The managed system it is on.

beyondtrust_new_secret_trigger.description: Runs for each new secret in BeyondTrust Secrets Safe. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.file_name: The file's name, for a file secret.
output.title: Its title.
output.urls: The web addresses saved with it.
output.username: The username, for a username and password.

beyondtrust_new_session_trigger.description: Runs for each RDP or SSH session that starts in BeyondTrust Password Safe. Sessions already open when the workflow is turned on don't start it, and one that starts and ends between two checks isn't seen. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.duration_seconds: How long it lasted, in seconds.
output.request_id: The request it belongs to, if any.
output.status_code: The status as Password Safe numbers it.
output.user_id: The id of the user who opened it.

beyondtrust_new_user_trigger.description: Runs for each new user in BeyondTrust. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.is_active: True if the user is active.
output.is_quarantined: True if the user is quarantined.
output.last_login_date: When the user last signed in.
output.name: First and last name.

beyondtrust_request_approved_trigger.description: Runs each time a request is approved in BeyondTrust. Ones approved before the workflow is turned on don't start it. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.
